_comment: Commissioner discipline under rule 10 (loss of a keeper round; see rule 13). Keyed by the season the penalty APPLIES to. target 'latest_round' = the penalty hits the declared keeper with the latest (highest-numbered) round, making that keeper cost `rounds` earlier.

2026.heading: 2025 League Discipline
2026.note: Assessed under rule 10 — a penalty of one keeper round for the 2025 season (see rule 13 for commissioner discretion). The penalty applies to the keeper with the latest round on each manager's 2026 slate.
